purpose: Inherited runtime components that every CRT SDK redistributes (libc/libm/libdl, the shell, the imported LLVM C++ runtime). tools/crt_runtime_notices.py turns this registry into the SDK's share/licenses/<name>/ notices, share/crt/dependencies/<name>/provenance.json and manifest redistributed_dependencies entries. Nothing here is a legal review: license_declared stays NOASSERTION unless the whole component is under one verified license text.

components.name: crt-libc
components.description: CRT libc, libm, libdl, startup objects and the public C headers (project-owned code plus per-file Bionic, OpenBSD gdtoa, FreeBSD msun, Android and kernel UAPI imports).
components.license_note: Mixed per-file licensing: project-owned code under LICENSE.md, imports keep their original license. share/licenses/crt-libc/NOTICE groups every distinct in-file license header.

components.name: mksh
components.description: MirBSD Korn Shell, imported from Android external/mksh (/system/bin/sh).
components.license_note: MirOS licence (and the permissive texts listed in NOTICE); not mapped to an SPDX identifier here.

components.name: toybox
components.license_note: The imported LICENSE text is the 0BSD permission notice (checked by tools/test_crt_runtime_notices.py).

components.name: onetrue-awk
components.license_note: Lucent Technologies 1997 permissive license; no SPDX identifier is asserted.

components.name: llvm-runtimes
components.description: Imported LLVM libc++, libc++abi and libunwind (pinned AOSP toolchain/llvm-project revision) and the compiler-rt builtins archive.
components.license_note: The LLVM Project license texts are vendored byte for byte from the pinned revision (libstdc++/third_party/llvm-license). They also carry the legacy MIT/UIUC dual-license sections for older contributions. The libclang_rt.builtins archive is produced by the toolchain used for the SDK build; its LLVM version is whatever that toolchain provides (SDK manifest records the compiler).
